# hetznerrobot_vswitch (Data Source)

Reads one vSwitch with its servers, subnets and cloud networks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_vswitch" "backend" {
  id = 4321
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric vSwitch id.

### Read-Only

- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether the vSwitch is cancelled.
- `cloud_networks` (Attributes List) Hetzner Cloud networks coupled to the vSwitch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_networks))
- `name` (String) Name of the vSwitch.
- `server_details` (Attributes List) The attached servers with their vSwitch status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_details))
- `servers` (Set of Number) Numbers of the attached servers.
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Subnets routed into the vSwitch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))
- `vlan` (Number) VLAN id.

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_networks`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String) Gateway.
- `id` (Number) Cloud network id.
- `ip` (String) Network address.
- `mask` (Number) Prefix length.


<a id="nestedatt--server_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server_details`

Read-Only:

- `server_ip` (String) Main IPv4 address of the server.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main IPv6 net of the server.
- `server_number` (Number) Server number.
- `status` (String) Status of the server in this vSwitch.


<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String) Gateway.
- `ip` (String) Network address.
- `mask` (Number) Prefix length.
